dataFreshness.explanation: Some calculations have explicit exclusions or unavailable inputs.

notes: IV, DVOL and realized volatility are fractions (0.36 = 36%).
vrp = implied minus realized volatility; descriptive, not a proven edge.

heldExpiryChains.units: Prices are USD per 1 contract of underlying. Best bid/ask are the highest bid and lowest ask across fresh venue quotes. IV, delta, gamma, theta and vega are medians of venue-reported values; theta is venue-reported USD per day and vega venue-reported USD per 1 vol point. Open interest and volume are summed contracts across venues.

limitations: Fees and venue trade history are unavailable; do not infer them as zero.

notes: History spot $86,400.00 is stale; current spot is in headline.
